title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Choose ten distinct study environments. Verify access rules, room or reservation constraints, and the physical affordance that makes each useful. Treat “Claimed by 9am” as editorial framing; never assert crowding or student behavior without evidence.

cards.title: Cowles Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Main campus library
cards.notes: Access the largest private academic library in Iowa for quiet individual study. Use the online SuperSearch tool to locate physical and digital resources while you work.
cards.short_summary: The central academic library at Drake offering traditional quiet study environments and extensive digital archives.
cards.evidence_claim: Cowles Library is the largest private academic library in Iowa and houses the University's general print and digital collections.
cards.access_notes: Open to students with Drake ID; check library website for seasonal hours.

cards.title: Collier-Scripps Collaboration Spaces
cards.subtitle: STEM and Education building
cards.notes: Utilize flexible collaboration spaces equipped with adjustable seating and large whiteboards. The glass-fronted design provides natural light for group study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A modern academic building featuring tech-enabled collaboration spaces and light-filled halls for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: Collier-Scripps Hall offers collaboration spaces with adjustable seating, large whiteboards, and technology for individual and group study.
cards.source_title: College of Arts & Sciences Facilities | Drake University
cards.access_notes: Academic building access typically follows class schedules; open to students.

cards.title: Olmsted Underground Meeting Rooms
cards.subtitle: Student union lower level
cards.notes: Find these rooms adjacent to Underground Fitness. They remain unlocked during building hours and feature whiteboards for active brainstorming and writing.
cards.short_summary: Quiet meeting rooms located in the lower level of the student union, available for student use when not reserved.
cards.evidence_claim: Underneath the Olmsted Center are two meeting rooms adjacent to Underground Fitness that are unlocked for student use as long as Olmsted is open.
cards.source_title: Study spots that are underutilized and underappreciated - The Times-Delphic
cards.access_notes: Available during Olmsted Center operating hours; check for posted reservations.

cards.title: Meredith Hall Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Journalism school building
cards.notes: Study in a building designed by modernist architect Mies van der Rohe. The second-floor lounge provides a central spot between journalism and mass communication labs.
cards.short_summary: A historic modernist building featuring a dedicated student lounge and updated classroom technology.
cards.evidence_claim: Meredith Hall, designed by Mies van der Rohe, includes a student lounge on the second floor (Room 204) and media lab spaces.
cards.access_notes: General academic building hours; typically 7am-10pm on weekdays.

cards.title: Aliber Hall Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Zimpleman College of Business
cards.notes: Located on the lower level, this reading room serves business students. The building also houses computer labs and conference rooms for professional group work.
cards.short_summary: The primary hub for business students, offering a dedicated reading room and specialized labs.
cards.evidence_claim: Aliber Hall's lower level contains a computer classroom, an accounting laboratory, and a student reading room.
cards.access_notes: Open during business school hours; lower level access may require Drake ID.

cards.title: Cline Atrium for Pharmacy and Science
cards.subtitle: Pharmacy and Science complex
cards.notes: Study in the glass-enclosed atrium connecting Harvey Ingham and Cline Hall. This space was specifically designed to facilitate peer collaboration and science study.
cards.short_summary: A modern glass atrium providing a collaborative environment for pharmacy and science students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Morgan E. Cline Atrium for Pharmacy and Science provides students a space to study and work with peers between Harvey Ingham and Cline Hall.
cards.source_title: distinctlyDrake brings visible changes to campus - Drake University Newsroom
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; connects multiple science facilities.

cards.title: Carnegie Hall Graphics Labs
cards.subtitle: Historic graphic design hub
cards.notes: Graphic design students have 24-hour access to advanced computer labs on the top floor. The building also features a large gathering space for critiques and discussion.
cards.short_summary: A historic Carnegie library repurposed into a 24-hour design studio and lab space for art students.
cards.evidence_claim: Carnegie Hall houses Drake's Graphic Design program with 24-hour access to two large advanced computer graphics labs for students.
cards.source_title: College of Arts & Sciences Facilities | Drake University
cards.access_notes: 24-hour access for authorized Graphic Design students; public access during day hours.

cards.title: Opperman Law Library Carrels
cards.subtitle: Law School library
cards.notes: Reserve a study carrel or use the group study rooms designed for focused legal research. The library supports various learning styles with quiet and collaborative zones.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library for law students featuring reservable carrels and quiet study resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Drake Law Library offers study rooms, reservable carrels, and study aids to support different learning styles.
cards.access_notes: Drake Law students have ID access 6 a.m. to 12 a.m. daily; visitor hours vary.

cards.title: Harvey Ingham Science Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Chemistry and Physics building
cards.notes: Utilize renovated study spaces within this historic science building. A glass skywalk connects you to Fitch Hall, allowing for easy movement between science labs.
cards.short_summary: Renovated science building offering modern study areas for chemistry and physics students.
cards.evidence_claim: Recent renovations have transformed Harvey-Ingham into a building containing state-of-the-art laboratories and study spaces for the sciences.
cards.source_title: Harvey Ingham Hall - Drake University Calendar
cards.access_notes: Open during academic hours; connected to Fitch Hall via skywalk.

cards.title: Goodwin-Kirk Beach Room
cards.subtitle: Residence hall study room
cards.notes: Sign out the key from the front desk to use this private study room. It offers a quiet alternative to the building's common areas for focused academic work.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated, reservable study room within a residence hall for student privacy.
cards.evidence_claim: Every dorm hall has an open study room for students, like the Beach Room in Goodwin-Kirk, where keys can be signed out at the front desk.
cards.source_title: Study spots that are underutilized and underappreciated - The Times-Delphic
cards.access_notes: Available to residents; key checkout required at the front desk.
